messages:
Jordan (Support): Heads up — Acme just opened an escalation: after last night's rollout their receipts generator started inserting random unrelated legalese into the 'terms' section. They sent examples. Customer says behavior started ~2026-03-16 23:40 UTC and affects ~12% of requests.

Ellie (Acme): yep, here's a redacted example we got: "...by the laws of Westeros, all disputes shall be settled..." Not acceptable for finance docs.

Jordan (Support): They included request/response logs. Request used model_id: rwd-infer-v2.1, prompt trimmed. Sending logs to #incidents for context. @Priya can you triage?

Priya (Eng): on it. Any chance this correlates with the deploy last night? Deploy-bot shows a canary -> stable promotion at 2026-03-16T23:15:12Z. @Marco any infra anomalies?

Marco (SRE): No infra alerts. Latency and error rates normal. Rolling restart for rwd-infer-v2.1 happened at 23:10 UTC. No host OOM.

Izzy (ML): thanks. First guess: model variant swap or new tokenizer handling for some edge prompts. Do we have model-serving config diff between old and new? @Priya can you share the serving config?

Priya (Eng): diffs: quantization profile changed from q8_dynamic -> q4f16 for this variant to reduce cost. Also, we enabled a new prefix-cache optimization on the runtime. Pushing diff to thread: https://kibana.example/changes/5623 (internal).

Jordan (Support): Customer says affected outputs have a distinct signature: unrelated legal clauses appended, often when the prompt includes the word "policy" or "terms".

Izzy (ML): q4f16 quantization can shift low-prob tokens in some heads — possible hallucination mode for rare tokens. Prefix-cache could exacerbate if key collisions happen. Repro steps incoming.

Priya (Eng): I can try repro locally with same model snapshot. Quick test:
```
# curl to local dev server
curl -s -X POST http://dev-local:8080/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-infer-v2.1","prompt":"Generate invoice terms: ..."}' | jq .
```
I get a clean response locally (no legalese) on my run.

Izzy (ML): can you run with quantization pinned to q8_dynamic and cache disabled?

Priya (Eng): running now.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion detected: rwd-infer-v2.1 -> stable @2026-03-16T23:15:12Z by ci/cd.

Priya (Eng): quick results: with q8_dynamic + cache disabled I reproduce clean. With q4f16 + cache enabled I reproduce the hallucinated legalese ~consistent with customer examples.

Marco (SRE): that's actionable. If q4f16 + cache is the culprit we should mitigate by routing Acme to the pre-rollout variant and schedule an urgent rollback for stable.

Sam (Oncall): I'm taking ownership for rollback window. Proposed mitigation: 1) Route Acme's traffic to rwd-infer-v2.1@q8_dynamic (existing earlier snapshot) via per-customer routing rule. 2) Revert stable variant to previous model artifact (rollback). 3) Disable prefix-cache global flag until we patch. 4) Notify customer.

Priya (Eng): Routing command (k8s/ingress rules managed by router-service):
```
# add route for Acme org id 5472
POST /routing/rules
{
  "org_id": 5472,
  "model_id": "rwd-infer-v2.1",
  "variant": "q8_dynamic",
  "priority": 100
}
```
I'll apply now.

Priya (Eng): applied route. Router confirms 100% of Acme traffic to pinned variant. Sending test link to Ellie to validate.

Ellie (Acme): testing now with the same payload... Received clean response. No weird legalese. :relieved:

Sam (Oncall): Good. Next: schedule rollback of stable to previous artifact (artifact sha: a1b2c3d). I'll orchestrate. Rollback ETA 15m.

Marco (SRE): Also toggling prefix-cache flag off on runtime nodes:
```
# runtime flag toggle
kubectl -n runtime exec deploy/runtime-config -- sh -c "curl -XPOST http://localhost:9000/flags/prefix_cache?enabled=false"
```
Turning off now; rolling restart 2 nodes to pick up config.

Priya (Eng): rollback started. CI job id: 7890. I'll monitor model performance and logs.

inc-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4387, severity: high, owner: Sam.

Priya (Eng): rollback complete. Stable now points to artifact a1b2c3d. Canary remains disabled for v2.1.

Izzy (ML): I pulled a sample of recent outputs from the metrics store. Error-type "append_hallucination_legal" spikes align perfectly with the time q4f16+cache was promoted. We'll run a targeted eval harness against 5k seed prompts including "terms"/"policy" tokens to measure false positive rate.

Sam (Oncall): Customer notified: Jordan sent status update and temporary routing resolved immediate customer impact. They asked for root cause and timeline for fix.

Jordan (Support): Acme appreciates fast action. They asked for regression postmortem and assurance this won't recur.

Priya (Eng): Next steps: 1) Reproduce minimal repro in a unit test. 2) Add quantization + cache interaction tests. 3) Adjust quantization config or disable q4f16 for sensitive templates. 4) Plan safe rollout with canary percentage gating and regression checks.

Izzy (ML): I'll own point 2 and 3. Hypothesis: q4f16 introduces low-prob token amplification in specific attention heads when prefix-cache hits align; fix could be mix of bias correction or disabling q4f16 for heads sensitive to legal/templated text.

Marco (SRE): I'll add a runtime sentinel metric: detect sudden increase in "unknown-token-insertions" pattern and trigger auto-fallback to previous variant for impacted orgs.

Sam (Oncall): Closing immediate incident: stable rollback + routing worked. We'll keep incident open until postmortem done. INC-2026-4387 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

Jordan (Support): Noted. I'll follow up with Acme with the postmortem ETA (EOD PST).

Ellie (Acme): Thank you everyone, appreciate the swift response.

Priya (Eng): Adding action items to the rollout checklist and gating. I'll link PR when tests are in: https://git.example/rwd/runtime/pulls/1024

Izzy (ML): I'll run targeted eval and share numbers in the incident ticket.

Sam (Oncall): Great work team. If anything regressions reappear ping here.

Priya (Eng): marking actions: rollout checklist update, unit test, disable q4f16 by default for v2.1 until proven safe.

Jordan (Support): I'll close customer loop after PMR is attached.

Marco (SRE): Keeping prefix-cache disabled globally for now; will coordinate re-enable after ML sign-off.

inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-4387 updated: mitigation applied, monitoring active.

Sam (Oncall): last note — we observed ~0.08% of global requests affected peak; Acme impact ~12% of their requests. Logged for billing/credits discussion.

Jordan (Support): copy that. Ending thread for now, will reopen if needed.
